title: npm dependency whose runtime files are generated by its own prepack hook; the generator never ships

source.exclude_note: paths removed from the scratch copy scanners see at source stage: build outputs and caches only, anchored to the project root so node_modules/*/dist and the like stay intact

artefact.note: the installed package alone: dist/ plus package.json, no generator

shipped.note: the package is visible, but dist/index.js was written by scripts/generate-dist.js at pack time and is not in the package's source
